structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page says the cheapest choice is a "פסגות" account with the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500" fund, ending with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, but I've never had dealings with פסגות and the screens filled up with red minus signs and English, so I'll ask you or the bank before I do anything.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the title and the buttons
stuck.why: It opens with 'להשקיע במדד' and English buttons (S&P 500, MSCI World). To me מדד is the price index on the news. Without the task I would have left right there.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes with sliders
stuck.why: Someone had already filled in 10,000 ₪ today, 500 ₪ a month, 10 years and 7%. I didn't know whether 7% was a promise or a guess, or whether I should change it.
The big number 86,492 ₪ stuck with me, but I wasn't sure what 'אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום' means, or whether 'הפקדתם 70,000' was money I had to put in.

stuck.where: Screen 2, two lists side by side
stuck.why: One list on the right with banks and one on the left with funds. I didn't know where to start or whether I had to pick from both.
Every line has a red minus amount, -447, -1,268, -4,492. I couldn't tell if that means I lose that money. It frightened me.

used: The title 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
The boxes: סכום היום 10,000, הפקדה חודשית 500, שנים 10, תשואה 7%
The bank list: פסגות 86,492 at the top, then לאומי 83,396, הבינלאומי, מסד, הפועלים, יהב
The fund name 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)' marked as הבחירה
skimmed: The text under the title about the S&P 500 index
The coloured bar and its legend at the top of screen 2 (דמי משמרת, המרת מטבע...)
The coloured labels on every fund (צוברת, קרן מחקה, חשיפה לדולר...)
The banks lower down: דיסקונט, מזרחי טפחות, אלטשולר...
The small grey line about the dollar rate and inflation
skipped: The funds with English names (iShares, Vanguard, IE00...)
The folds under each bank ('לא בחישוב...')
Screens 5 to 10, I didn't get there
unsure_meaning: מדד (in the sense of a stock index)
The red minus amounts next to every fund
The two numbers under each bank (86,492 and 1,057). Which one is what I pay?
The colours in the bars, orange, yellow and red, which I couldn't tell apart
The dotted underline under the numbers
not_found: Anything about deposits or safe saving
Whether my money could lose value, in plain words
A clear sentence saying 'this is what to do'
Who is behind the site 'מקור', and whether it's official

findings.what: Red minus signs on almost every line in the fund list. It looks like losses and it scared me away.
The cheapest one is פסגות. It isn't my bank and I've never had dealings with it, so I wouldn't give it money.
English words and codes I can't read: S&P, MSCI, iShares, IE00B5BMR087, 4D
Very busy screens: two lists side by side, many coloured labels and numbers. I didn't know where to start.
The sliders come already filled in, including 7% a year, without saying whether that's certain
Small grey text I could barely read (the dollar rate, the folds under the banks)
findings.where: Screen 1 under the boxes, screens 2-4 on the right

findings.what: Words I don't know: דמי משמרת, נאמן, צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד, קרן מחקה
Bars in orange, yellow and red that are too close to tell apart
Dark background with pale text, hard to read even with glasses
